release_objective: Repository foundation only; stop with an open independently reviewable PR.

phases.objective: Repository foundation, CI/CD foundation, and enforced pull-request controls.
phases.authority: The attached user request authorizes scoped files, repository settings, working branch and PR creation; it prohibits merge and application work.
acceptance_criteria: Local validation and current revision CI succeed with a fail-closed terminal gate.
Read-only GitHub verification confirms effective main protections and missing approval blocks the PR.
Main-only source archive delivery is configured and has not executed before merge.
stop_conditions: Stop with the foundation PR open; do not merge or advance to application work.
Report unavailable protections or reviewer prerequisites without weakening controls.
